amb.cage.name: amb.cage
amb.cage.note: enormous hangar: sub room tone, far coolant bubbling, thermal metal ticks

amb.car_interior.name: amb.car_interior
amb.car_interior.note: closed car: 4-cyl engine tone, road, wind, joint thumps

amb.cicadas.name: amb.cicadas
amb.cicadas.note: hot noon: ~40 resonator-driven cicada voices, slow chorus swells

amb.city_night.name: amb.city_night
amb.city_night.note: wind between towers, canyon whistles, far two-tone and chirping alarms, one far thud

amb.geofront.name: amb.geofront
amb.geofront.note: vast airy quiet, distant water in a huge cavern, a few birds

amb.hq.name: amb.hq
amb.hq.note: air handling, 60 Hz electrical hum, a faint high ballast pair, rare duct ticks

amb.lake.name: amb.lake
amb.lake.note: dark flooded chamber: drips in a wet hall, beating low hum, lapping water

amb.plug.name: amb.plug
amb.plug.note: sealed capsule: close, muffled, a 1 Hz machine pulse

amb.plug_flooded.name: amb.plug_flooded
amb.plug_flooded.note: the same capsule filled: underwater-dull, bubbling, the same pulse

amb.town_empty.name: amb.town_empty
amb.town_empty.note: wind, singing wire, far crossing bell twice

amb.tunnel.name: amb.tunnel
amb.tunnel.note: rail wagon in a tunnel: rumble, rail-joint clacks in tunnel reverb, pressure whooshes

music.cage.name: music.cage
music.cage.note: the hangar after the lights: a held cold open-fifth pad with a 9th, glass bells falling E5 -> D5 every 5 s, sub drone, thin air

music.decision.name: music.decision
music.decision.note: while the player decides: a heartbeat that tightens from 48 to 104 bpm over 90 s while a tone creeps up by semitones and a cluster and noise grow; the last 13.85 s are the loop cycle (music.decision_loop)

music.decision_loop.name: music.decision_loop
music.decision_loop.note: the end section of music.decision, seamless: 24 beats at 104 bpm with the held tension tone, cluster and ticking; play it right after music.decision

music.defeat.name: music.defeat
music.defeat.note: 8 s: a low blow, a dissonant pad collapsing downward as its filter closes, a detuned bell dying, then only reverb

music.descent.name: music.descent
music.descent.note: the reveal: grows from nothing, a held breath at 7.4-7.9 s, then the BLOOM at exactly 8.0 s (wide chord, choir pad, bell, sub), bells and chord shifts, fading to nothing at 50 s

music.dread.name: music.dread
music.dread.note: the monster appears: a sub heartbeat every 4 s, a slow dissonant cluster swelling and fading, reversed metal swells, a thin high pair

music.father.name: music.father
music.father.note: almost nothing: one sustained low tone (D2 over a D1 floor) and one high thin tone (A6) with a slow beat, breathing over 20 s

music.fight.name: music.fight
music.fight.note: the battle: 152 bpm, 40 bars; kick/taiko and cannon-snare, chromatic low-brass ostinato, dissonant dyad stabs, tremolo pad; sections of 8 bars add layers and bar 25-28 break down

music.fight_final.name: music.fight_final
music.fight_final.note: the last phase: 172 bpm, 48 bars; double-time bass, high mallet 16th ostinato, tritone stabs, a siren-like tone rising every 8 bars

music.launch.name: music.launch
music.launch.note: builds for exactly 20 s (12 bars at 144 bpm: drone, taiko density doubling, rising noise and tone, low brass swells) then drives (16-bar cycle of low-brass ostinato and drums, twice); the cycle is music.launch_loop

music.launch_loop.name: music.launch_loop
music.launch_loop.note: the 16-bar drive of music.launch, seamless (26.67 s at 144 bpm); loop it until the surface

music.resolve.name: music.resolve
music.resolve.note: 12 s release: a last thump, the cluster sliding by semitones into D major add9, a warm choir swell, an exhale of noise, one bell, a long tail

music.road.name: music.road
music.road.note: the drive: a muted 3+3+2 mallet ostinato over a plucked bass, brushed shaker, soft pulse, chord changes every 8 bars (Dm Bb Gm A)

music.victory.name: music.victory
music.victory.note: 40 s, exhausted quiet then dawn: wind and a faint sub, slow bells, a D major add9 chord blooming from nothing, a breathing sustain, high shimmer, fading out

sfx.air_open.name: sfx.air_open
sfx.air_open.note: 3 s: confined rumble opening out, a bandpassed whoosh widening, then the room's huge tail

sfx.alarm_cut.name: sfx.alarm_cut
sfx.alarm_cut.note: a two-tone alarm stopping dead, leaving only the corridor's tail

sfx.alarm_loop.name: sfx.alarm_loop
sfx.alarm_loop.note: EXTRA: the two-tone alarm that sfx.alarm_cut stops (3.2 s = 64 ticks, loops); 700/940 Hz, same timbre

sfx.barrier.name: sfx.barrier
sfx.barrier.note: a blow stopping dead on a wall of light: muffled thwomp, a ringing cluster of glassy partials, combed shimmer

sfx.beam_charge.name: sfx.beam_charge
sfx.beam_charge.note: 2 s rising: whine, accelerating discharge ticks, a deep swell, cut off at its peak

sfx.beam_fire.name: sfx.beam_fire
sfx.beam_fire.note: a particle beam: crack and sub boom, then a roaring FM and sawtooth core with sizzle, decaying through city echoes

sfx.birds_up.name: sfx.birds_up
sfx.birds_up.note: a flock taking off: ~30 birds of wing-flap flutter plus startled calls, wire twang

sfx.bolt_1.name: sfx.bolt_1
sfx.bolt_1.note: one huge lock bolt releasing: crack, sub, plate and bar ring (variant 1)

sfx.bolt_2.name: sfx.bolt_2
sfx.bolt_2.note: one huge lock bolt releasing: crack, sub, plate and bar ring (variant 2)

sfx.bolt_3.name: sfx.bolt_3
sfx.bolt_3.note: one huge lock bolt releasing: crack, sub, plate and bar ring (variant 3)

sfx.booth_light.name: sfx.booth_light
sfx.booth_light.note: small switch, tube strike ping, a flickering buzz settling to a faint hum

sfx.breaker.name: sfx.breaker
sfx.breaker.note: one bank of lights: contactor chatter and clunk, ballast hum rising, lamp corona

sfx.breaker_1.name: sfx.breaker_1
sfx.breaker_1.note: one bank of lights: contactor chatter and clunk, ballast hum rising, lamp corona (variant 1)

sfx.breaker_2.name: sfx.breaker_2
sfx.breaker_2.note: one bank of lights: contactor chatter and clunk, ballast hum rising, lamp corona (variant 2)

sfx.breaker_3.name: sfx.breaker_3
sfx.breaker_3.note: one bank of lights: contactor chatter and clunk, ballast hum rising, lamp corona (variant 3)

sfx.breathing.name: sfx.breathing
sfx.breathing.note: EXTRA (cue 6 'own breathing'): a close, muffled breath cycle inside a helmet-like space, 8 s = 2 breaths, loops

sfx.bridge_slide.name: sfx.bridge_slide
sfx.bridge_slide.note: a massive walkway sliding away: rumble fading with distance, rail squeal, wheel clatter, soft end stop

sfx.car_alarms_far.name: sfx.car_alarms_far
sfx.car_alarms_far.note: EXTRA (cue 1 'car alarms far off'): three distant car alarms of different patterns over each other, 9 s

sfx.car_arrive.name: sfx.car_arrive
sfx.car_arrive.note: engine rising as it approaches, tyre squeal and scrub, suspension settling, idling

sfx.car_door.name: sfx.car_door
sfx.car_door.note: door slam: body thump, panel ring, double latch click, seal puff

sfx.car_drop.name: sfx.car_drop
sfx.car_drop.note: the car falls back onto its wheels: suspension thud, springs, loose metal and glass, rocking creaks

sfx.car_roll.name: sfx.car_roll
sfx.car_roll.note: a car going over twice: four body hits with glass, a long slide, settling clinks and steam

sfx.car_start.name: sfx.car_start
sfx.car_start.note: starter cranking, engine catching, settling to idle

sfx.card.name: sfx.card
sfx.card.note: the single low hit under a title card: sub boom, membrane, beater, dark hall

sfx.chains.name: sfx.chains
sfx.chains.note: EXTRA (cue 5.21 'chains swing'): heavy chains clinking as they swing after a blow, 5 s

sfx.contact.name: sfx.contact
sfx.contact.note: the plug walls turning to glass: a shimmering cluster of high partials, FM glints, a rising airy sweep, a clear wide pad

sfx.core_crack.name: sfx.core_crack
sfx.core_crack.note: a big crystalline sphere splitting: accelerating cracks with glassy rings, ice-squeals, a final split and thud, tinkling shards

sfx.crash.name: sfx.crash
sfx.crash.note: aircraft into ground: falling engine scream, impact, metal pile, scrape, fireball whump, fire crackle

sfx.cross.name: sfx.cross
sfx.cross.note: a pillar of light: a pure sine climbing three octaves, a synthetic vowel choir on an open D chord, shimmer, cathedral reverb

sfx.door_boom.name: sfx.door_boom
sfx.door_boom.note: the cage door shutting: crack, sub boom, plate and bar rings, bolt clunks, hangar reverb

sfx.door_heavy.name: sfx.door_heavy
sfx.door_heavy.note: bulkhead: latch release, hydraulic hiss and whine, groaning swing, thud and seal

sfx.dust_fall.name: sfx.dust_fall
sfx.dust_fall.note: fine dust sifting down: soft hiss, tiny grains, an occasional pebble

sfx.ears_ringing.name: sfx.ears_ringing
sfx.ears_ringing.note: 8 s fading tinnitus: two near-detuned tones per ear, pressure thrum, a trace of hiss

sfx.elevator_arrive.name: sfx.elevator_arrive
sfx.elevator_arrive.note: brake clunk, a soft two-note tone (C5, G5), air settling

sfx.elevator_doors.name: sfx.elevator_doors
sfx.elevator_doors.note: servo whine, rail slide, soft end stops, servo down

sfx.explosion_far.name: sfx.explosion_far
sfx.explosion_far.note: a blast several kilometres off: delayed, dulled, long hill echoes

sfx.explosion_near.name: sfx.explosion_near
sfx.explosion_near.note: a close blast: crack, fireball, sub, debris, city echoes

sfx.eyes_on.name: sfx.eyes_on
sfx.eyes_on.note: quiet ominous power-up: a low drone climbing, beating high tones, filament hiss, a muffled seat-click

sfx.fluid_fill.name: sfx.fluid_fill
sfx.fluid_fill.note: 8 s: trickle and bubbling, a cavity resonance climbing as the chamber fills, then everything submerged and dull

sfx.footfall_giant.name: sfx.footfall_giant
sfx.footfall_giant.note: a colossal step far away: felt sub first, then the crunch, then the ground settling

sfx.gate_close.name: sfx.gate_close
sfx.gate_close.note: huge blast door: drive motor spooling up, heavy slide with rail creaks, final boom and bolts, tunnel reverb

sfx.giant_hit.name: sfx.giant_hit
sfx.giant_hit.note: the giant taking a blow: body thud, wet slap, armour plate, a short organic grunt, falling debris

sfx.giant_punch.name: sfx.giant_punch
sfx.giant_punch.note: the giant landing a blow: swinging whoosh, a heavy concussion, plate crack, a small blast of dust and rattle

sfx.gunfire_far.name: sfx.gunfire_far
sfx.gunfire_far.note: three bursts of aircraft cannon far off: dull thump + crack per round, open-air echoes

sfx.gurney.name: sfx.gurney
sfx.gurney.note: hospital bed on two squeaking casters, 6 s, whole wheel revolutions so it loops

sfx.hand_rise.name: sfx.hand_rise
sfx.hand_rise.note: something vast rising out of liquid: cascading water, deep creaks, a morphing formant groan, vast hall

sfx.hatch_close.name: sfx.hatch_close
sfx.hatch_close.note: capsule hatch: clang, accelerating ratchet, pressure hiss, the outside going dull

sfx.heartbeat.name: sfx.heartbeat
sfx.heartbeat.note: 10 s, nine lub-dubs at 54 bpm with a little irregularity, chest-muffled

sfx.impact_above.name: sfx.impact_above
sfx.impact_above.note: the fortress struck from the surface: muffled colossal blow, structure groaning, debris ticks, hangar reverb

sfx.impact_above_hard.name: sfx.impact_above_hard
sfx.impact_above_hard.note: a worse one: double blow, steel tearing, more groaning and debris

sfx.jet_pass.name: sfx.jet_pass
sfx.jet_pass.note: Doppler fly-past: turbine roar, tonal whine and rumble all riding the Doppler curve

sfx.jolt.name: sfx.jolt
sfx.jolt.note: ground shock: sub thump, rolling rumble, resonant window panes chattering

sfx.klaxon.name: sfx.klaxon
sfx.klaxon.note: alert klaxon: three raspy pulses with an onset glide, in a corridor, 4 s

sfx.lake_ring.name: sfx.lake_ring
sfx.lake_ring.note: EXTRA (cue 5.21 'the lake rings'): the red lake sloshing and a low resonant ring after a blow, 7 s

sfx.launch.name: sfx.launch
sfx.launch.note: catapult: a brutal kick, then a roaring ascent (a rising turbine tone and quickening ring-lights over the roar); it ends in phase with the start of sfx.launch_roar, so play that straight after and loop it until cut

sfx.launch_arrive.name: sfx.launch_arrive
sfx.launch_arrive.note: the lift locking at the top: clang, clamps, hydraulic hiss, groaning settle, open-air wind coming in

sfx.launch_charge.name: sfx.launch_charge
sfx.launch_charge.note: 3 s whine climbing exponentially with a second voice, accelerating arcing ticks and a swelling sub

sfx.launch_roar.name: sfx.launch_roar
sfx.launch_roar.note: the 6 s seamless roaring ascent that sfx.launch ends on; loop it until cut

sfx.lights_flicker.name: sfx.lights_flicker
sfx.lights_flicker.note: ballast hum stuttering on and off with relay ticks and snaps

sfx.mine.name: sfx.mine
sfx.mine.note: 0.0 s rising whine cut dead at 0.4 s; digital silence 0.4-2.4 s; the blast at 2.4 s with a long rolling tail

sfx.pa_chime.name: sfx.pa_chime
sfx.pa_chime.note: three soft metallic notes D5-A5-F5 (own design), speaker-band-limited, in a corridor

sfx.phone_hangup.name: sfx.phone_hangup
sfx.phone_hangup.note: handset back on its cradle: plastic clack, bounce, switch click

sfx.phone_pickup.name: sfx.phone_pickup
sfx.phone_pickup.note: hook-switch ticks, plastic handset, cord rustle

sfx.rig_crash.name: sfx.rig_crash
sfx.rig_crash.note: a lighting rig hitting something hard: sub thud, a pile of plates, shattering glass, a pipe rolling away

sfx.rig_tear.name: sfx.rig_tear
sfx.rig_tear.note: bolts popping, steel tearing with a rising rasp, cables snapping, then a falling whistle

sfx.siren.name: sfx.siren
sfx.siren.note: city air-raid siren, two 10 s rise-and-fall cycles, rotor chop, echoing off the streets

sfx.speak_chime.name: sfx.speak_chime
sfx.speak_chime.note: 'your turn': two soft rising notes A5 -> E6, a gentle marimba-like timbre, tiny room; deliberately unlike every other chime

sfx.sync_rise.name: sfx.sync_rise
sfx.sync_rise.note: a tone climbing for 4 s while detuned voices converge, locking into a just-intoned D chord that holds and fades

sfx.train_start.name: sfx.train_start
sfx.train_start.note: coupling clunk, electric drive winding up, rail clacks accelerating, rumble swelling

sfx.train_stop.name: sfx.train_stop
sfx.train_stop.note: brake squeal falling, clacks slowing, pneumatic hiss, final shunt
